meta.title: Optimize BigInt hex conversion
meta.body_summary: Optimize BigInt::to_hex performance by replacing string concatenation with StringBuilder and fixed-size digit buffers, while preserving hexadecimal output behavior.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex replaced string concatenation in BigInt::to_hex with StringBuilder; human reviewer caught redundancies and edge cases, leading to fixes and test additions before merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 84 changed lines, this is a small, focused edit that fits a typical micro-optimization. It was merged after multiple review iterations addressing correctness and style, consistent with the small-scale change.

review_details.concern_detail: Human reviewer peter-jerry-ye pointed out redundant zero-initialization of digits array (since array already prefilled with '0'), a missing early return for negative sign and zero value, and a subtle condition bug in padding logic. Copilot bot also suggested replacing magic ASCII codes and adding unit tests.
review_details.performance_claim: Use StringBuilder to avoid quadratic string concatenation overhead in hex conversion loops.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: repeated_string_concat with magic numbers in original to_hex implementation

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Core library optimization with StringBuilder and fixed-size arrays is within agent's implementation capability; merge required resolving subtle correctness issues pointed out by human reviewer.

detection_detail.code_reading: peter-jerry-ye manually reviewed the diff and provided inline comments on logic issues such as redundant zero assignment and missing negative sign handling.
detection_detail.ci_auto: coveralls bot reported 100% coverage on changed lines and a small overall increase; peter-jerry-ye-code-review[bot] offered automated suggestions to avoid string concatenation and magic numbers.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing data or benchmark; only narrative claim that StringBuilder improves performance. Correctness tests were added but performance was not measured.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After review feedback, commits were made to remove redundant code, fix condition, and add test cases; all changes were done within the PR before merging.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored BigInt::to_hex to use a pre-allocated StringBuilder and per-limb FixedArray buffer for digit collection, eliminating repeated string concatenation and manual zero-padding. Added early return for zero and simplified hex digit conversion logic.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file added to cover edge cases exposed by the refactor; most changes are in the implementation file.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: replaced string concat with StringBuilder and FixedArray.
Follow-up commit 'chore: improve code' addressed redundancy in digit initialization.
'test: show bug exposed by coverage' added a failing test.
'fix: use correct condition' adjusted padding condition and updated test.
Final 'chore: improve readability' commit clarified comments.

review_signals.summary: Recommended using StringBuilder in loops to avoid quadratic string concatenation, already implemented in new version.
Suggested replacing magic ASCII codes with character literals and adding unit tests for to_hex edge cases; also noted ambiguous variable name 'idx'.
Recommends using '0'.reinterpret_as_int() instead of magic number 48 for readability.
review_signals.action_taken: Acknowledged by human reviewer peter-jerry-ye as 'Reasonable suggestion' but not directly addressed in this PR.

review_signals.summary: Reported 100% coverage on changed lines and overall coverage increase to 90.117%.
Stated the modification seems reasonable but noted subtle issues; no formal approve/block.
Pointed out that setting digits[0] = '0' is redundant because the array is already initialized with '0'.
review_signals.action_taken: Fixed in subsequent 'chore: improve code' commit.

review_signals.summary: Suggested adding a leading '-' for negative BigInts and a shortcut for zero to avoid extra work.
review_signals.action_taken: Partially addressed; zero early return was already present, negative sign handling not added in this PR.

review_signals.summary: Agreed with Copilot's suggestion to replace magic number 48, calling it 'Reasonable suggestion'.

Author (bobzhang) and maintainer made several follow-up commits to address the issues and add tests.
PR merged on 2025-06-23 after ~11.5 days total, with all concerns resolved.
